title: Retrospective Analysis of radiological Outcome, Patient Satisfaction and Complications after revision Total Knee Arthroplasty with a prospective Follow-up
summary: The aim of this study is to assess the functional outcome and patient satisfaction after revision knee replacement surgery. In particular, the degree of coupling used in the prosthesis, various radiological parameters, such as joint line reconstruction, and the indication for revision surgery will be analyzed. Furthermore, complications occurring during the follow-up period will be recorded.
